body:
pagerbot: INCIDENT OPENED • Sev2 • routing-service • incident_id=R-2026-3512346789
pagerbot: paging on-call: @akshat, @maria

akshat: grabbing it. alerts for ~20m showing embeddings endpoint returning text payloads + some 502s from downstream. customers reporting search vectors gone weird.

maria: seeing router errors. lots of resolve logs where alias 'search/emb@org-42' reads pin -> model-id 'm-v2-embed-2026' but model-meta shows interface=instruct. router then falls back to a chat variant.

sam: can you paste an example log?

dina: log snippet below:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:09Z routing.resolve alias=search/emb@org-42 -> pin:model=m-v2-embed-2026
2026-03-15T02:11:09Z model-store.get m-v2-embed-2026 -> metadata:{"interface":"instruct", "quant":"int8"}
2026-03-15T02:11:09Z router: endpoint_type=embeddings compatibility_check=FAIL -> fallback_variant=chat-small-v1
```

akshat: so the pin exists but the model tag is wrong. that would cause embedding requests to be routed to a chat runtime—explains text responses.

eve: flagged impacted customers list. Org-42 (SearchApp) got affected; CS reported incorrect payloads for ~35 minutes. requesting immediate rollback and customer comms.

sam: was this a recent model metadata update?

leo: noticed a model meta push ~1h ago: commit 9f3b5, author=ml-onboarder, which set interface=instruct for m-v2-embed-2026. looks like a copy/paste mistake from an instruct model.

maria: router currently tolerates incompatibility and falls back to keep availability. for embeddings->chat this is silently wrong. we should stop that.

dina: mitigation options:
- rollback alias pin to m-v1-embed-2025 (fast, immediate)
- change router to block incompatible fallback (needs rollout)
- mass-scan pinned aliases to detect interface mismatches (nightly job)

akshat: roll back pin now. ops, please apply and report change id.

ops-bot: action: unpin alias search/emb@org-42 -> removed m-v2-embed-2026; restored m-v1-embed-2025 (change_id=CHG-9901)

akshat: traffic looks normal; embedding response schema back to vectors. monitoring: embed_success 98.1% -> 99.9% over 3m.

eve: CS updated: SearchApp confirms sampling tests look good post-rollback. asked for RCA and ETA for fixes.

sam: collecting evidence for RCA: routing logs, model-meta commit diff (9f3b5), onboarding job logs, alias pin history. Dina can you attach the onboarding CI logs?

dina: attached. root cause draft:
- human error during model onboarding set metadata interface=instruct for an embed model (m-v2-embed-2026)
- alias pinning did not validate model interface -> allowed mismatched pin
- router fallback policy permitted routing to incompatible chat variant, resulting in textual payloads returned to embeddings endpoint

maria: proposed follow-ups (order by priority):
1) block alias pin if model.metadata.interface != alias.endpoint_type (PR: repo/routes, owner=akshat)
2) change router fallback for endpoint_type mismatches to fail-fast and trigger an alert (PR: repo/router, owner=maria)
3) add a pre-commit metadata linter in the onboarding flow to catch bad 'interface' tags (PR: repo/onboard, owner=dina)
4) add a monitoring rule: pinned_alias_interface_mismatch -> page SRE (rule in prometheus)

akshat: creating tickets and assigning: AKSHAT -> pin validation PR-701; MARIA -> router fallback PR-702; DINA -> onboarding linter PR-703; SAM -> customer comms and timeline.

eve: suggested customer timeline: immediate rollback done; pin validation within 48h; router hard-block within 7d; onboarding linter in 14d. customer asked for a written summary and a point of contact. sending draft now.

leo: also found an internal test alias pinned to the same bad model. rolled back there too as precaution.

maria: no further alerts. closing the paging. leaving incident open for RCA and postmortem.

pagerbot: incident status: mitigated -> follow-up P0 created for RCA (R-2026-3512346789).

sam: quick snippet for RCA doc:
```
resolve(alias=search/emb@org-42)
  read pin -> m-v2-embed-2026
  read model-meta -> interface: instruct
  endpoint_type=embeddings -> compatibility FAIL
  router fallback -> chat-small-v1 -> returned text schema
```

dina: note: chat fallback returned 200 with JSON body like {"text": "...", "tokens": [...] } which is invalid for embedding clients expecting numeric vectors.

akshat: agreed change in policy: incompatible fallback should be treated as an error and trigger immediate paging. safety over availability for type mismatches.

eve: sending customer email now summarizing rollback and next steps. cc: akshat, sam, maria.

maria: scheduling a 1h RCA with eng, SRE, product, CS tomorrow. will attach artifacts in follow-up ticket.

akshat: thanks all. incident mitigated and rollback applied. will draft timeline and postmortem. reopen if regressions appear.

pagerbot: INCIDENT MITIGATED • final_state=rollback_applied • linked_change=CHG-9901
